messages:
Anika: heads-up: sample-app CI red. embeddings.rerank_async returns a generator object in v0.9.3 and our pydantic typing expects List[float].

Diego: can you paste the failing assert or traceback?

Anika: traceback snippet: TypeError: object of type 'generator' has no len() from tests/test_rerank.py:42 assert isinstance(res['scores'], list)

Samir: interesting. I think the async batcher yields a generator to stream items but we accidentally return it upstream instead of materializing. Sync path materializes into list for memory-safety but public API agreed to return lists.

Liam C: any chance this is related to retry/auth wrapper? we had a bug where retry returned a streaming wrapper on transient 401.

Anika: I saw transient 401s earlier in CI logs but the current run that fails didn't show auth errors. The generator appears even on a clean run.

Samir: minimal repro:
```python
from redwood import Client
import asyncio
client = Client(api_key="test")
async def t():
    r = await client.embeddings.rerank_async(["q"], ["a","b"])
    print(type(r['scores']))
asyncio.run(t())
```
prints <class 'generator'> on my machine.

Diego: ok that matches. I can repro locally. The async helper uses 'yield from' in _stream_items and we return its generator; sync path calls list() on the stream.

Liam C: proposed fix list: (1) materialize streaming results in public async API (convert to list) (2) update type hints to Sequence[...] and document streaming variant on low-level call only (3) add unit test asserting list type parity (4) add small migration note.

Samir: will do but careful: some customers use streaming for memory-sensitive workloads. We should keep a low-level async_stream method that yields items, and keep top-level rerank_async guaranteed to return lists. Add private method name _stream_rerank_async for advanced use.

Anika: that sounds right. Also please make sure the high-level docstring explicitly says "returns lists" so Sphinx autodoc reflects it. Our onboarding guides assume list outputs.

Samir: creating PR w/ changes: materialize + type hints + tests + docs. Also adding a small CI integration that runs sample-app smoke to catch this. PR link will be posted.

sdk-bot: PR #3251 opened by Samir: fix(async): ensure rerank_async returns materialized lists, expose low-level stream variant, add tests + docs. https://git.redwood.dev/r/redwood/sdk/pull/3251

Diego: nice. can we also add a lint rule to forbid generator return types in public API surface?

Liam C: good idea. add mypy stub check and a unit-level assertion in API tests.

Anika: will re-run sample-app CI after merge. thanks all :thumbsup:
